input: Search the web for youth sports or skill "clinics" held in the summer for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Asheville Tennis Association
candidates.note: 2026 junior tennis clinics at Aston Park and around Buncombe County; also ran a free five-day tennis camp.

candidates.name: KP Volleyball Training
candidates.note: 2026 summer volleyball camps and skills clinics for middle/high school players; locations include Candler and Fletcher.

candidates.name: UNC Asheville
candidates.note: Summer athletics camps and clinic registration across multiple sports; also offers overnight teen pre-college and STEAM programs.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer youth recreation programs and camps; athletics department also offers clinics, though summer clinic dates were not available.

candidates.name: Asheville Racquet Club
candidates.note: 2026 all-sports summer camps for ages 5–14, including tennis and pickleball instruction; half- and full-day options.

candidates.name: Asheville Buncombe Youth Soccer Association
candidates.note: 2025–2026 summer soccer skill programs include FUNdamentals and competitive camps for children and teens.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer skill and sports camps open to community schoolchildren; most sessions are half-day.
